newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates finish lower at 24/24.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates finish lower at 24/24.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary' overnight interbank interest rates fell on Thursday from their recent highs as the market was more liquid than the players expected for the end of the year, dealers said.
The overnight rates finished at 24.00/24.50, compared with the opening between 27.25 and 28 percent, dealers said.
"Everybody expected high rates due to the (December 20) tax-payment and because there are less working day then usual in this reserve period," said Takarekbank's Istvan Zsoter.
"But the panic is over and now they see the situtation clearly," said Inter-Europa Bank's Balazs Varga.
Varga added that according to market rumours the amount of corporate taxes to be paid on December 20 would be lower than previously expected.
However, some dealers said that the overnight rates would climb up again on Friday due to the tax-payments. Other dealers expected stagnation or further fall.
